programs.title: Freaky Ali
programs.desc: A sports comedy film that tells the story of a poor man who discovers his natural talent for golf and decides to pursue a career in the sport. With the help of his friend and coach, he enters a tournament to compete against professional golfers and prove himself. The movie highlights themes of determination, hard work, and overcoming social barriers in an entertaining and uplifting plot.

programs.title: Zed Plus
programs.desc: A political satire set in a small town in Rajasthan, where the local government is on the verge of collapsing due to factors such as corruption and mismanagement.

programs.title: One Day: Justice Delivered
programs.desc: A judge bound by law has to pass unfair judgments on some criminal cases due to lack of evidence. After retirement, he becomes a vigilante and decides to punish the crooks who walk free.

programs.title: Barsaat
programs.desc: The actions of Sabarwal, a trickster in the guise of a high-profile businessman, lead to the death and imprisonment of innocent people. The affected victims decide to take revenge on the trickster.

programs.title: Bollywood Movie
programs.desc: The Movie Club +2 broadcasts Bollywood and popular Indian cinema on a two-hour time-shifted delay, allowing viewers to catch missed movies on India's free ad-supported streaming platforms.
